\[
P=A-\frac13(B-A).
\]

Given \(AP:PB=1:4\), \(AP\) is \(\frac13\) of \(AB\), so

\[
\overrightarrow{AP}=-\frac13\overrightarrow{AB}.
\]

Thus

\[
P=A-\frac13(B-A)
=A-\frac13B+\frac13A
=\frac43A-\frac13B.
\]

\[
(t,u)=\left(\frac43,-\frac13\right).
\]
